description: How to book one venue: its booking platform and link from the Dim Hour catalog. For SevenRooms venues only, given a date, it also returns real bookable times from SevenRooms. Times are a snapshot from SevenRooms at checkedAt. No table is held. Confirm on the booking page before telling anyone it is booked. Other platforms (Resy, OpenTable and the rest) return no times and a times_note saying so. Given a date, a venue whose stored link is a Resy venue page, an OpenTable /r/ page or a Tock venue or search page also gets booking_url_for_date: the same booking page opened on that date and party size (and time, where the platform takes one). Other link shapes get none and keep booking_url only. It is a link, not a table: nothing is held or checked.

date.description: Day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, no times are read.

time.description: Preferred time, HH:MM 24-hour, used in booking_url_for_date where the platform takes one (OpenTable, Tock). Default 19:00. Reads no times.
